mapper.insert: INSERT INTO places (external_api_id, name, address, category, latitude, longitude) VALUES (#{apiContentId}, #{name}, #{addr}, #{category}, #{lat}, #{lng})
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, address, latitude, longitude, NULL AS thumbnailUrl FROM places WHERE name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') ORDER BY name ASC LIMIT 20
